text_block_list.text:
One day on the way home,
as I passed through the shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
They're up to something.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...A hot spring trip, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Do I like it...? I guess? Whenever a big job wraps up,
my manager takes me there as a reward.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Though I've never gone there myself...

I suddenly remember that I received a lottery ticket
when I shopped here before.
choice_data_list: Wanna give it a shot, then?
Wanna give it a shot, then?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...
Let's do this.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Can I try turning it?

Gold City slowly
turned the handle of the lottery wheel!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ooh...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it hit...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm seriously freaked out.
I can't believe it comes out that easily...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Does this mean I—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Maybe the gods gave ya a little bonus
'cause you're so pretty, little lady!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Actually, I really don't need this.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
D... Did I
say something wrong, maybe?!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
That's always how it goes with me.
Mom's always scolding me for not knowing when to keep my mouth shut...
Whoa, I went and made the little miss mad!

After placating the shopping district staff,
I hurriedly chased after Gold City
with the "Hot Springs Trip Voucher" in hand...!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...That old guy,
we didn't offend him, did we?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I know that person
doesn't mean any harm, but...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...I mean, it was your ticket, but I went ahead and acted on my own.
choice_data_list: I brought it for you, so don't worry!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Seriously?
In that situation?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You're actually pretty shrewd,
aren't you?
choice_data_list: This ticket is something you drew in with your own power.
You drew this ticket yourself with your own strength.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Nah, it's fine. I don't need it.
Taking it now would be super uncool."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You use it. That one.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Even if I went now, I doubt I'd enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway... congrats, I guess?
Later."

"...And so, I ended up holding onto
the hot springs trip ticket for the time being."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Whoa, it's huge.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still, it looks so tasty...
And the carrot glacé is so shiny.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: "Talk about overkill... If I eat all of this, my manager's gonna get so mad at me..."
choice_data_list: ...Does that mean you're not confident you can adjust?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Who do you think you're talking to?
I'll have you know I'm a pro at weight management.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: All right, let's do this.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Even if I eat all of this, I'll keep my figure in shape.
Just watch me, okay?

"—On this day, Gold City savored a delicious hamburger steak...
and naturally kept her figure in check."

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh. A mountain of food.
That helps.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You know, carrots are supposed to be
really good for your skin and all.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"Plus, above all, it tastes amazing.
Being able to keep it stocked is a lifesaver.
I'll leave it with my manager."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...By the way, I've been wondering.
You guys aren't really that into carrots, are you?"
choice_data_list: Though there are people who love it.
There are people I love, though.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Still, there wouldn't be any scramble for it, right?
I mean, Tracen Academy has an insanely high number of menu items with carrots in them.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure there are girls who hate carrots,
but you don't really hear about 'em much.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I talked about carrots in a magazine column before,
but nobody really reacted much except for other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I remember thinking it was so bizarre.
Carrots are delicious, after all.
choice_data_list: You really love carrots, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...When I told my manager that exact same thing,
she started carrying carrot sticks around
wherever she goes.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind, but...
When I say I like it, I just mean normally. The other day too—
Even after that, sparking from the topic of carrots, I listened to Gold City talk about her manager on the way home.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Just one, huh.
Hard to find a use for that.
choice_data_list: Won't that make a huge portion once cooked?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Don't underestimate Umamusume.
Seriously, this ain't gonna be nearly enough.
choice_data_list: Now to add the other ingredients...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, like that?
I mean, I already figured.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Cooking, cooking, huh...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Do I really
need to tell you that?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"...Just curious, though.
What would you make with this carrot?"

On the way back afterward, I walked along
teaching Gold City the recipe.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I don't have one.
I mean, I'm technically a model, you know?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Using my one and only chance just to get pocket tissues...
Honestly, it's hilarious.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Still, that's just way too unlucky. What a bummer...
